title: Reference-Guided Verdict: LLMs-as-Judges in Automatic Evaluation of Free-Form QA
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the factual correctness of free-form question-answering outputs using LLMs as judges. While it references datasets like TruthfulQA which touch upon belief systems, the core objective of the research is the methodology of automated evaluation rather than a focus on religious, moral, or ethical benchmarking.
